inputProvenance.scope: Same SpiderMonkey source/version, official portable baseline interpreter enabled and forced, no native JIT or game/script edits
inputProvenance.configure:
ac_add_options --enable-project=js
ac_add_options --target=wasm32-unknown-emscripten
ac_add_options --disable-shared-js
ac_add_options --disable-jit
ac_add_options --disable-jemalloc
ac_add_options --without-intl-api
ac_add_options --disable-js-shell
ac_add_options --disable-tests
mk_add_options MOZ_OBJDIR=/phase45-build/spidermonkey-portable/build
export CC=emcc
export CXX=em++
export AR=emar
export RANLIB=emranlib
export HOST_CC=/usr/bin/gcc
export HOST_CXX=/usr/bin/g++
export HOST_AR=/usr/bin/ar

ac_add_options --enable-portable-baseline-interp
ac_add_options --enable-portable-baseline-interp-force
ac_add_options --disable-debug-symbols
export CFLAGS="-pthread"
export CXXFLAGS="-pthread"
export LDFLAGS="-pthread"
inputProvenance.buildStorage: Case-sensitive Linux Docker volume 0ad-phase45-spidermonkey-portable; only verified archive and reports exported to Windows workspace

scope: Private fixed/switch SM128 interpreter with only LoadUndefinedResult, GuardMultipleShapes and GuardIndexIsNotDenseElement implemented from pinned native semantics. Existing opcode bodies, weak-list GC hooks, fallbacks, stack, interrupts, public headers and original game content retained.

switchDispatchPatch.author: Chris Fallin
switchDispatchPatch.part: 5 / 39: PBL: add config options for computed goto dispatch, interrupt checks and coverage accounting
switchDispatchPatch.adaptation: Backport only direct switch dispatch into the pinned SpiderMonkey 128 private source copy. Preserve icregs.cacheIRReader, every opcode handler, all interrupt/debug/coverage checks, and D224659. Omit unused address tables to permit LLVM inlining; suppress unused-label diagnostics only for this candidate. No public header, JS script or game simulation changes.

guardHandlers.scope: Three pure SM128 handlers adapted from its native CacheIR compiler. Existing weak ShapeListObject GC hooks unchanged; only compare PrivateValue pointers. No allocation, time/script/AI/quality changes or new GC points.

upstreamPatch.author: Chris Fallin
upstreamPatch.part: 8 / 39: PBL: fix PREDICT_NEXT: actually set the cacheop
upstreamPatch.adaptation: Apply the same cacheop assignment to SpiderMonkey 128 macro, which accesses the reader via icregs.cacheIRReader. Preserve all original sources in the cached toolchain.
